question: For ports that are bound to security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c and have status DOWN, show the port ID, port status, allocated IP address, the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each network (ordered by standard attribute ID), and the dense rank of the port when ordering by its port-security setting using a window frame that includes the current row and the 2 preceding rows.   p.status AS port_status,
  ia.ip_address AS allocated_ip_address,
  SUM(p.standard_attr_id) OVER (
    PARTITION BY p.network_id
    ORDER BY p.standard_attr_id
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_sum_standard_attr_id,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY psb.port_security_enabled
    ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb
  ON sgpb.port_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia
  ON ia.port_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN portsecuritybindings psb
  ON psb.port_id = p.id
WHERE sgpb.security_group_id = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c'

  p.status AS port_status,
  ia.ip_address AS allocated_ip_address,
  SUM(p.standard_attr_id) OVER (
    PARTITION BY p.network_id
    ORDER BY p.standard_attr_id
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

  DENSE_RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY psb.port_security_enabled

FROM ports p
JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb
  ON sgpb.port_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia
  ON ia.port_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN portsecuritybindings psb
  ON psb.port_id = p.id
WHERE sgpb.security_group_id = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c'
  AND p.status = 'DOWN';
